name: Ascencia Shelter
notes: Low-barrier emergency shelter. Accepts walk-ins when beds available. Pet-friendly rooms limited.

name: Union Rescue Mission – Glendale Outreach
notes: Overflow shelter beds available during winter months. Referral through 211 recommended.

name: First United Methodist Church
notes: Offers hot meals on Sundays after service. Food pantry available Wednesdays. No ID required.

name: Glendale Community Church of God
notes: Provides hygiene kits, socks, and clothing referrals. Spanish and Armenian spoken.

name: Salvation Army Glendale Corps
hours: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm (social services); emergency lodging by referral
notes: Case management and emergency financial assistance available. Call ahead for shelter referral.
